bounded_question: Can a current unresolved question open adjacent historical cause and deeper causal history inside the real COMP shell while preserving explicit current-versus-historical status, bounded disclosure, semantic origin and exact return without creating a permanent Archive/History mode or replay/rollback semantics?
frozen_inputs: PKT-COMP-04-01 contextual/deep inspection and exact return grammar
Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted causal/history inspection grammar and source-derived Scene 12 ledger-question fixture
construction_law: The current Scene 12 question 'Why did Elara hide the second ledger?' remains the semantic origin.
Adjacent cause is explicitly historical and secondary to the current question.
Deeper causal history may become temporary task depth but remains explicitly historical at every level.
Selection or keyboard focus inside history never promotes historical material into current-state material.
Back and Close restore the same current question, selection and originating focus target.
Back/Close are navigation only; no replay, rollback, undo, branching or current-state rewrite is implied.
Causal relevance may be explained without freezing an exhaustive graph, inference model, score or generated-explanation authority.
Private/Character-bounded knowledge, claims, beliefs, memories, uncertainty and provenance remain bounded where Product authority supports them.
mechanical_acceptance: zero page-level and internal horizontal overflow in current/adjacent and deep-history states
zero missing button accessible names and zero undersized icon-only controls
history activation succeeds in both themes while the current semantic origin remains named
historical witnesses remain structurally/textually marked in all themes and forced-colors
deep history is exclusive task depth rather than a second simultaneous app mode
Back and Close restore the history trigger focus and current-question selection
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: History must be reached from current meaning rather than becoming durable Archive/History navigation.
Current question must remain more semantically primary than adjacent historical cause.
Historical status must survive Light/Dark, selection, focus, expansion and forced-colors without relying on color alone.
Deep history must retain the current Production/Scene/question origin and exact return path.
Darkness must not become 'past' semantics and Lightness must not become 'current authority' semantics.
Narrow layout must preserve current question -> historical cause -> deeper history ordering.
explicit_non_goals: consequence review, replay, rollback, branching or mutation mechanics
exhaustive causal graph, inference engine, causal score or generated explanation authority
production tokens or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Responsive and interaction-plumbing repairs may change geometry/DOM mechanics only. Any change to accepted temporal/disclosure semantics or frozen visual mechanisms requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-06 retuning.
